normalIntro.en: Outstretch is out plus stretch, so the picture is simple pressure outward until something lies fully open.
normalIntro.cn: outstretch 就是 out 加 stretch，画面很简单：向外用力，直到东西完全摊开。

normal.en: Its past tense and participle are both outstretched, and that form is the most common use today.
normal.cn: 它的过去式和过去分词都是 outstretched，而这正是今天最常见的用法。

normal.en: The third person is outstretches, with the usual es after the ch sound.
normal.cn: 第三人称单数是 outstretches，因为 ch 音后面要加 es。

normal.en: Out- in this family means outward or beyond, as in outstretched and outnumbered.
normal.cn: 这个家族里的 out- 表示向外或超出，见于 outstretched 与 outnumbered。

normal.en: Latin extendere gave English extend, which now sits beside native stretch in the same field.
normal.cn: 拉丁语 extendere 与 stringere 都与英语 stretch、extend 相关，所以这个家族很宽。

normal.en: In modern prose the adjective outstretched is far more common than the bare verb.
normal.cn: 在现代散文里，形容词 outstretched 比光秃秃的动词常见得多。

abstract.en: Imagine fingers pushing hard against the air until they cannot go one millimetre further.
abstract.cn: 想象手指用力顶着空气，直到连一毫米都再也推不动。

abstract.en: Picture a plain unrolling toward the horizon with nothing blocking the way.
abstract.cn: 想象一片平原朝地平线摊开，中间没有任何阻挡。

abstract.en: Think of a hand reaching toward a door handle that is just out of reach.
abstract.cn: 想象一只手伸向门把手，还差一点点够到。

examples.en: The child ran to her with outstretched arms.
examples.cn: 孩子张开双臂朝她跑去。

examples.en: A wide beach outstretches along the bay for several miles.
examples.cn: 一片宽阔的海滩沿着海湾绵延数英里。

examples.en: Several delays had outstretched the patience of the passengers.
examples.cn: 几次延误已经超出了乘客的耐心。

dict_mnemonic.text: 「奥特 stretch」——像奥特曼那样把双臂整个向外伸平，就是伸开；这只是谐音联想，与词源无关。

root: out-（向外、超出）+ 古英语 streccan（伸展）→ 向外伸展、铺开；借喻「超出限度」；同族有 stretch、stretcher、stretchy。

sensesIntro.en: Outstretch begins with the physical act of holding something out at full length, then spreads to landscapes, reaching hands, over-stretched fabric, taut lines, limits, and throws.
sensesIntro.cn: outstretch 先从把东西整个伸展铺开的身体动作出发，再扩散到景物绵延、伸手、布料被拉长、拉直绷紧、超出限度以及投掷。

core.en: CORE IMAGE: arms opened wide until the fingers can reach no further.
core.cn: 核心意象：双臂完全张开，手指再也伸不远了。

branches.en: The basic physical sense spreads a limb or a cloth to its full length.
branches.cn: 最基本的物理义，是把肢体或布匹整个摊到最长。

branches.en: The same openness applied to land gives the landscape sense of stretching across a plain.
branches.cn: 把同样的开阔感用于地面，就得到平原横铺的大地义。

branches.en: Reaching and casting both push a hand outward toward a target.
branches.cn: 伸手和投掷都是把手朝目标向外推出去。

branches.en: Stretching too far or just enough shows up as loosened fabric and taut wires.
branches.cn: 拉伸过头或拉得恰到好处，分别表现为松掉的布料和绷紧的铁丝。

branches.en: Going past the boundary is the figurative extension of out- as beyond.
branches.cn: 越过边界是 out- 表示「超出」时的比喻延伸。

intro.en: Outstretch pairs the native English prefix out- with the verb stretch, and its family spreads through stretcher, stretchy, and stretched.
intro.cn: outstretch 把英语本族的前缀 out- 与动词 stretch 配在一起，它的词族延伸到 stretcher、stretchy 和 stretched。

latinIntro.en: Stretch has no Latin source, so Latin appears here only through later loanwords such as extend and distend.
latinIntro.cn: stretch 没有拉丁语来源，所以拉丁语只通过后来借入的 extend、distend 等词出现在这里。

definition_zh: 比……重；比……更重要；胜过
definition_en: to be heavier than something else, or to be more important or valuable than it
core_image: 天平一端托盘被重重压下，另一端高高翘起
scene: 农贸市场的摊主把两种谷物放进天平的托盘里，左边那堆明显沉了下去。The trader put the two sacks on the scale and watched one side outweigh the other.
sceneCN: 这里 outweigh 是「比……重」（第 1 个义项：在重量上压过对方）；句意：摊主把两袋谷物放上天平，看着一边比另一边重。

collocations.zh: 比风险更重要；风险更大
远远超过；远远更为重要
比对手更有分量、更占优势

derivatives.zh: 由 weigh 派生，古英语 gewiht 意为「重量」，并作动词表示「加重」
由 weight 加 -y 构成，义为「沉重的；有分量的」
由 weigh 加 -ing 构成，义为「称重；权衡」

senses.title: To be heavier than something
senses.definition: to have a greater weight than another object on a balance or scale
senses.definitionCN: 在天平或秤上比另一物体拥有更大的重量
senses.example: This crate outweighs the one next to it by ten kilos.
senses.exampleCN: 这个板条箱比旁边那个重十公斤。
senses.why: Out- means more than, and weigh means to measure mass, so the two together say the scale tips your way.
senses.whyCN: out- 表示「超过」，weigh 表示称量，两者合起来就是秤朝你这边沉下去。

senses.title: To be more important than something
senses.definition: to matter more than another factor or concern
senses.definitionCN: 比另一个因素或考虑更为重要
senses.example: Safety at work outweighs speed of delivery every time.
senses.exampleCN: 工作中的安全在任何时候都比交货速度更重要。
senses.why: On an old balance scale, the heavier side decides, so weight became a picture of importance.
senses.whyCN: 在古老的杆秤上，重的一边说了算，于是「重量」成了「重要」的比喻。

senses.title: To be of greater value or benefit
senses.titleCN: 好处大过（坏处）；价值胜过
senses.definition: to bring greater benefit or value than a loss, a cost, or a rival
senses.definitionCN: 带来的好处或价值超过损失、成本或对手
senses.example: The savings in fuel outweigh the higher price of the car.
senses.exampleCN: 省下的油费超过这辆车更高的价格。
senses.why: Weighing goods against coins is a fair comparison, so the heavier side wins on value as well.
senses.whyCN: 拿货物对铜钱称重是最朴素的比较，所以重的一边在价值上也赢。

senses.title: To be more serious than something
senses.definition: to be more serious or grave than another problem or harm
senses.definitionCN: 比另一个问题或危害更为严重
senses.example: The damage to the reef outweighs any short term profit.
senses.exampleCN: 对珊瑚礁的破坏超过任何短期收益的严重程度。
senses.why: Grave matters are heavy matters, so the metaphor lets bad news go on the scale too.
senses.whyCN: 严重的事情在人们心里是沉重的，所以这个暗喻也能让坏事上秤。

senses.title: To have more influence or force
senses.definition: to carry more influence or justification than an opposing argument or force
senses.definitionCN: 比对方的论据或力量更有说服力和正当性
senses.example: In the debate, evidence outweighed emotion.
senses.exampleCN: 在辩论中，证据的力量超过了情绪。
senses.why: To outweigh arguments is to let the heavier set of reasons pull the balance down.
senses.whyCN: 让论据「更重」，就是让更有分量的那组理由把秤盘压下去。

senses.title: To compensate for a loss
senses.definition: to make up for a disadvantage or shortfall by being greater in another way
senses.definitionCN: 通过在另一方面更大而弥补某项劣势或亏损
senses.example: The extra holiday time outweighs the lower pay.
senses.exampleCN: 额外的休假时间抵得上较低的工资。
senses.why: If one pan is light, the other must hold more to bring the beam level, which is exactly compensation.
senses.whyCN: 如果一边轻，另一边就得多放些东西才能让横梁平，这正好就是补偿。

senses.title: To count for more in a statistic
senses.definition: to receive a larger share of a total or average because of its size or weight
senses.definitionCN: 因其体量或权重而在总数或平均值中占更大份额
senses.example: Transport costs outweighed all other items in the family budget.
senses.exampleCN: 交通开支在家庭预算中占了比所有其他项目都大的比重。
senses.why: In averages, bigger numbers count heavier, so the verb maps neatly onto weighted figures.
senses.whyCN: 在平均值里，大数字的「分量」更重，所以这个词很自然地对应到加权数字上。

intro.en: Outweigh joins out- with weigh, and weigh itself comes from the Old English verb wegan, to carry or move.
intro.cn: outweigh 由 out- 与 weigh 组合而成，而 weigh 本身来自古英语动词 wegan，意为扛起、移动。

items.en: The reconstructed root wegh means to carry or to move in a vehicle.
items.cn: 重构词根 wegh 意为扛运，或用载具搬运。

items.en: Wegan means to carry, move, or lift, and it carries the sense into modern weigh.
items.cn: 古英语 wegan 意为扛、移、举起，这个词义的脉络一直延续到今天的 weigh。

items.en: Weien means to weigh on a balance and is related to the Old Norse vega.
items.cn: 中古英语 weien 意为用天平称重，与古诺斯语 vega 有亲缘关系。

items.en: Outweigh is formed and first means to be heavier than another thing.
items.cn: 16 世纪成型，最初意为比另一样东西更重。

items.en: The metaphorical sense of being more important than something spreads.
items.cn: 「比……更重要」的比喻义逐渐流行起来。

items.en: Today the figurative sense far outweighs the literal one in everyday use.
items.cn: 如今在日常使用中，比喻义远远多于字面义。

note.en: Outweigh belongs to the weigh and weight family, and its near neighbours compare scale, importance, and winning.
note.cn: outweigh 属于 weigh 与 weight 词族，它的近邻包括与称重、重要性、胜过有关的词。

entries.definition: to measure how heavy something is
how heavy a thing is
to beat someone by being cleverer
to be the strongest or most common element
to be greater than a number or limit
the state of two sides being equal in weight or value
entries.definitionCN: 平衡；均衡，是天平的两边

normalIntro.en: Outweigh is out plus weigh, a scale where the heavier pan decides which side wins.
normalIntro.cn: outweigh 就是 out 加 weigh，在天平上哪边重，哪边就说了算。

normal.en: The past tense and participle are both outweighed, and the base verb weigh is regular as well.
normal.cn: 过去式和过去分词都是 outweighed，基础的动词 weigh 也是规则的。

normal.en: Latin pensare and pendulum share the weighing image with weigh.
normal.cn: 拉丁语 pensare 与 pendulum 和 weigh 共享「称重」的画面。

normal.en: Out- here means more than, so outweigh means both heavier than and more important than.
normal.cn: 这里的 out- 表示「超过」，所以 outweigh 既是「更重」，也是「更重要」。

normal.en: The most common object is benefits, risks, costs, or advantages, because the verb compares them.
normal.cn: 最常见的宾语是 benefits、risks、costs、advantages，因为这个词是在作比较。

normal.en: Compare outnumber and outgrow: out- turns a measure into a comparison and then into a win.
normal.cn: 对比 outnumber 与 outgrow：out- 把度量变成比较，再变成胜负。

abstract.en: Picture a brass balance with one pan pressed almost to the table.
abstract.cn: 想象一杆黄铜天平，一边的秤盘几乎压到了桌面。

abstract.en: Think of a shopping list where benefits sit on one side and costs on the other.
abstract.cn: 想象一张购物清单，好处放在一边，花费放在另一边。

abstract.en: Imagine a debate table where one stack of evidence is clearly taller.
abstract.cn: 想象辩论桌上两边各摆一摞证据，其中一摞明显更高。

examples.en: The advantages of living here outweigh the drawbacks.
examples.cn: 住在这里的好处多于坏处。

examples.en: Her health outweighed every other consideration in the decision.
examples.cn: 在这项决定中，她的健康比任何其他考虑都重要。

examples.en: Outweighed by cheaper imports, the local mill closed in spring.
examples.cn: 由于被更便宜的进口货比了下去，本地那家磨坊在春天关张了。

dict_mnemonic.text: 「奥特 威」——像奥特曼一样力气大，一下就「威」到把对方压下去，就是比对方重、比对方重要；这只是谐音联想，与词源无关。

root: out-（超过）+ weigh（古英语 wegan，扛起、称重，与 weight 同源）：在天平上更重，由此比喻为「比……更重要」；同族有 weight、weighty。

sensesIntro.en: Outweigh starts as pure weight on a scale, then turns into importance, value, seriousness, influence, compensation, and finally statistical weight.
sensesIntro.cn: outweigh 先指天平上的纯粹重量，再转指重要性、价值、严重程度、影响力、补偿，最后指统计上的分量。

core.en: CORE IMAGE: a balance whose heavy pan sinks while the other rises.
core.cn: 核心意象：天平上重的一盘沉下去，另一盘翘起来。

branches.en: The literal sense weighs two objects and finds one heavier.
branches.cn: 字面义是把两样东西称一称，发现其中一个更重。

branches.en: Weight on a scale becomes weight in an argument or in influence.
branches.cn: 秤上的重量变成论据中的分量，或影响力中的轻重。

branches.en: Weighing goods against cost shows up as benefit and as compensation.
branches.cn: 拿货物对成本称重，体现为好处与补偿。

branches.en: A grave matter is a heavy matter, which gives the seriousness sense.
branches.cn: 严重的事情在心理上是沉重的，这就有了「更严重」的义项。

branches.en: In statistics the heaviest entry holds the largest share of the total.
branches.cn: 在统计里，分量最重的条目占据总数中最大的份额。

intro.en: Outweigh is out- plus weigh, and its family runs through weight, weighty, and weighing.
intro.cn: outweigh 是 out- 加 weigh，它的词族经 weight、weighty、weighing 一路延伸。

latinIntro.en: Weigh comes from Germanic sources, while Latin offers kin such as pensare, which also means to weigh.
latinIntro.cn: weigh 来自日耳曼语源，而拉丁语提供了 pensare 这样的同义亲缘词。

definition_zh: 智胜；以智谋胜过；用计骗过
definition_en: to defeat or gain an advantage over someone by being cleverer
core_image: 棋盘对面的人眉头紧锁，你轻轻推下一子，把他的整盘计划封死
scene: 谈判桌前，对方的底牌被你一句轻描淡写的话探了出来。The young negotiator outwitted a veteran opponent with a single well-placed question.
sceneCN: 这里 outwit 是「智胜」（第 1 个义项：在较量中用头脑胜过对手）；句意：那位年轻谈判者用一句恰到好处的提问智胜了一位老练的对手。

pos.zh: 智胜；以智取胜；用计骗过

derivatives.zh: outwit 的核心词根，义为「智慧；机智」
wit 加 -y 构成，义为「机智的；诙谐的」
与 wit 同源，由「知道」引申为「目击者；证人」

senses.title: To defeat by being clever
senses.definition: to beat an opponent in a contest by being more clever or resourceful
senses.definitionCN: 在较量中凭更聪明或更有办法而战胜对手
senses.example: The young champion outwitted a far more experienced rival.
senses.exampleCN: 那位年轻的冠军智胜了一位经验丰富得多的对手。
senses.why: Out means beyond, and wit means mental sharpness, so to outwit is to put more wit into play than the other side can match.
senses.whyCN: out 表示「超出」，wit 表示「心智的敏锐」，所以 outwit 就是让对方在智谋上无力匹敌。

senses.title: To get past by cunning
senses.definition: to get around a person, rule, or system by cunning, deception, or a clever trick
senses.definitionCN: 借助狡猾、欺骗或巧妙的把戏绕过某人、某规则或某系统
senses.example: Smugglers often outwit the customs checks with hidden compartments.
senses.exampleCN: 走私者常在货物中做暗格来骗过海关检查。
senses.why: The same idea widens from a fair contest to any target, so the verb also covers outsmarting rules, guards, or machines.
senses.whyCN: 同一个概念从正面较量扩展到任何对象，所以也可指用巧计绕过规则、守卫或机器。

senses.title: To be too clever for someone
senses.titleCN: 在智谋上胜过；比某人更精明
senses.definition: to show oneself to be sharper in judgment than another person, often noted in hindsight
senses.definitionCN: 显示出判断力比另一人更敏锐，常带事后回顾的意味
senses.example: The detective was outwitted by a quiet witness.
senses.exampleCN: 那位侦探被一个沉默寡言的目击者比了下去。
senses.why: Because the wit sits inside the verb, the passive form pictures the loser standing on the wrong side of a quicker mind.
senses.whyCN: 因为「机智」藏在动词里，被动式便把落败者描绘成站在更快头脑的对立面。

senses.title: A contest of minds
senses.definition: a situation in which people compete to see whose thinking is quicker
senses.definitionCN: 人们互相比拼谁的思维更快的局面
senses.example: The final round became a pure outwit between two grandmasters.
senses.exampleCN: 最后一轮成了两位特级大师之间的纯粹斗智。
senses.why: Nominal uses turn the act of outwitting into a kind of game, stressing the mental duel rather than the result.
senses.whyCN: 名词化用法把「智胜」这个动作变成一种博弈，强调的是心智对决而非结果。

senses.title: To trick in storytelling
senses.definition: in fiction or folklore, to sidestep a stronger enemy through a clever deceit
senses.definitionCN: 在虚构作品或民间故事里，用巧妙的欺骗躲开比自己强的敌人
senses.example: The farmer outwits the giant three times in the tale.
senses.exampleCN: 在这个故事里，农夫三次用计骗过了巨人。
senses.why: Folktales keep the oldest pattern: wit against brute strength, so the verb names the hero action of a trickster tale.
senses.whyCN: 民间故事保留了最古老的模式：以智对力，于是这个动词就成了「智多星式主人公」的标志性动作。

senses.title: To be fooled by a ruse
senses.definition: to be fooled because another person used a clever plan that was not noticed in time
senses.definitionCN: 因为他人用了来不及察觉的巧计而受骗
senses.example: The guards were outwitted by a false alarm at the gate.
senses.exampleCN: 守卫们被大门口的一起假警报骗了过去。
senses.why: When the agent is the object of the verb, the trick works and the sharpness belongs to the other side, so the sense leans on being caught out.
senses.whyCN: 当施动者成为宾语时，说明计谋奏效、机智属于对方，于是这个义项偏重「被识破得太晚、被套住」。

intro.en: Outwit joins the native prefix out, meaning beyond, to the noun wit, from a Germanic root meaning to know.
intro.cn: outwit 由本土前缀 out（超出）加上名词 wit 构成，后者出自日耳曼语词根，意为「知道」。

items.en: The reconstructed root witan means to know or to have seen.
items.cn: 一般认为，重构词根 witan 意为「知道」或「见过」。

items.en: Wit appears as witt, meaning mind, senses, or understanding.
items.cn: 古英语中写作 witt，意为心智、感知或理解。

items.en: The verb witan, to know, stands behind the noun.
items.cn: 同源的动词 witan（知道）是名词 wit 的来源基础。

items.en: Wit spreads from knowledge to mental sharpness and cleverness.
items.cn: 中古英语中 wit 从「知晓」扩展到「心智敏锐、机灵」。

items.en: The prefix out forms verbs of surpassing such as outdo and outlive, and outwit follows this pattern.
items.cn: 前缀 out 构成 outdo、outlive 等表示「胜过」的动词，outwit 沿用这个模式。

items.en: Outwit is recorded as to surpass in wit and now also covers outsmarting rules and systems.
items.cn: outwit 被记录为「在机智上胜过」，现代又扩展到用巧计胜过规则与系统。

note.en: Outwit belongs to the out- family of surpassing verbs and sits beside cleverness words such as outsmart, outfox, and outmaneuver.
note.cn: outwit 属于 out- 系列的「胜过」动词，与表示机灵的 outsmart、outfox、outmaneuver 相邻。

entries.definition: the ability to think quickly and cleverly
clever and amusing in speech or writing
entries.definitionCN: 言辞机智的；妙趣横生的

entries.definition: a person who sees an event, from the same verb as wit
entries.definitionCN: 目击者；与 wit 同源，核心是「知道」

entries.definition: to defeat by being cleverer
to trick someone by cunning
to make someone believe something untrue

normalIntro.en: Outwit is built from two visible parts: out for beyond and wit for mind.
normalIntro.cn: outwit 可以拆成两截看清：out 是「超出」，wit 是「心智」。

normal.en: Think of out as to surpass and wit as mental sharpness.
normal.cn: 把 out 想成「胜过」，把 wit 想成「头脑的锋利」。

normal.en: Outwit belongs with outdo, outlive, and outgrow, which all take out- for beyond.
normal.cn: outwit 与 outdo、outlive、outgrow 同族，都用 out- 表示「越过」。

normal.en: The noun wit also gives witty and wits.
normal.cn: 名词 wit 还衍生出 witty 与 wits（理智）。

normal.en: Remember the double t in outwitted and outwitting.
normal.cn: 记住 outwitted 与 outwitting 里的双写 t。

normal.en: The passive be outwitted by means the other side was cleverer than you.
normal.cn: 被动式 be outwitted by 表示对方比你更聪明。

abstract.en: Picture a chess player quietly placing one piece that traps the whole board.
abstract.cn: 想象一位棋手轻轻放下一子，把整盘棋都封住了。

abstract.en: Imagine a locksmith opening a gate without breaking it.
abstract.cn: 想象一位锁匠不砸门就打开了闸门。

abstract.en: Think of a fox crossing a hunter trail backward to lose the scent.
abstract.cn: 想象一只狐狸倒着穿过猎人走过的路，让气味断掉。

examples.en: The chess prodigy outwitted the champion in only twelve moves.
examples.cn: 那位棋坛神童只用了十二步就智胜了冠军。

examples.en: Hackers try to outwit security systems with clever code.
examples.cn: 黑客试图用巧妙的代码骗过安全系统。

examples.en: She felt outwitted by a negotiator with much more patience.
examples.cn: 她觉得自己被一位更有耐心的谈判者比了下去。

dict_mnemonic.text: 「奥特的机智」——把 out 听成「奥特」，把 wit 听成「机智」，想象奥特满脑子机智地把对手比下去；这只是谐音联想，与词源无关。

root: 本土前缀 out-（超出、胜过）+ 古英语 witt（知识、心智，动词为 witan「知道」）→ outwit「在机智上胜过」；同族的 outdo、outlive 都用 out- 表示越过。

sensesIntro.en: Outwit starts with winning a contest of minds, widens to getting past rules or guards by cunning, then shifts to hindsight judgments, the duel itself, trickster tales, and the experience of being caught out.
sensesIntro.cn: outwit 先指在智力较量中取胜，再扩展为用计绕过规则或守卫，随后转向事后的胜负评价、斗智本身、智多星故事以及「被套住」的体验。

core.en: CORE IMAGE: a single quiet move that shuts the whole board.
core.cn: 核心意象：一个安静落子，封死整盘棋。

branches.en: Winning a fair contest of minds is the central sense.
branches.cn: 在公平的智力较量中取胜是最中心的义项。

branches.en: Getting past rules or guards is the cunning sense.
branches.cn: 用计绕过规则或守卫是「狡猾」义项。

branches.en: An active contest and a passive judgment describe the same duel from two sides.
branches.cn: 主动的较量与被动的评价，是同一场斗智的两个侧面。

branches.en: The noun form names the duel itself rather than its result.
branches.cn: 名词化用法命名的是斗智过程本身，而非结果。

branches.en: Folktales turn wit against strength into a repeatable plot.
branches.cn: 民间故事把「以智对力」变成可反复讲述的情节。

intro.en: Outwit is built from the native prefix out and the noun wit, so its parts are worth learning one by one.
intro.cn: outwit 由本土前缀 out 与名词 wit 组成，因此值得把这两个部件分开来学。

latinIntro.en: There is no Latin element here: wit is a Germanic word and out is a native English prefix.
latinIntro.cn: 这个词没有拉丁成分：wit 是日耳曼语词，out 是英语本土前缀。

items.example: Out- turns outwit into a verb of surpassing.
items.exampleCN: out- 让 outwit 成为表示「胜过」的动词。

items.example: Wit is the idea-bearing part of outwit.
items.exampleCN: wit 是 outwit 的核心词义部件。

items.example: Old English witt already means the mind.
items.exampleCN: 古英语 witt 已表示「心智」。

items.example: Witan is the verb behind the noun.
items.exampleCN: witan 是名词背后的同源动词。

items.example: The suffix -y forms witty from wit.
items.exampleCN: 词尾 -y 把 wit 构成 witty。

items.example: Witty keeps the sharpness of wit.
items.exampleCN: witty 保留了「机敏」的意味。

items.example: The suffix -ed makes outwitted.
items.exampleCN: 词尾 -ed 构成 outwitted。

items.example: Outsmart shares the out- pattern with outwit.
items.exampleCN: outsmart 与 outwit 共用 out- 的构词模式。

items.example: Outdo shows out- meaning beyond.
items.exampleCN: outdo 显示 out- 表示「超出」。

items.example: Outfox follows the same out- pattern.
items.exampleCN: outfox 沿用同一个 out- 模式。

definition_zh: 卵巢；子房
definition_en: the organ in a female animal, or the lower part of a flower, in which eggs or seeds are produced
core_image: 一朵花的底部鼓起一个小囊，囊里整整齐齐排着一粒粒待熟的种子
scene: 生物课上，老师把一朵未开放的花从中间剖开。The teacher cut the flower in half and pointed to the ovary at its base.
sceneCN: 这里 ovary 是「子房」（第 2 个义项：花中包裹胚珠的部分）；句意：老师把花从中间剖开，指着它底部的子房。

derivatives.zh: ovary 加 -an 构成形容词，义为「卵巢的；子房的」
共享 ov- 词根，义为「胚珠；小卵」
拉丁语 ovum（卵），是 ovary 的词根来源
ovo-（卵）+ -oid（像……的），义为「卵形的」

senses.title: The egg-producing organ
senses.definition: either of the two organs in a female body in which eggs are produced
senses.definitionCN: 女性或雌性动物体内产生卵子的两个器官之一
senses.example: Each ovary releases an egg during the menstrual cycle.
senses.exampleCN: 每个卵巢在月经周期中排出一个卵子。
senses.why: The Latin word means egg-keeper, so the organ named after the egg is the oldest and central sense.
senses.whyCN: 拉丁词的本义是「藏卵之处」，因此以「卵」命名的器官是最古老、最中心的义项。

senses.title: The seed chamber in a flower
senses.definition: the hollow part at the base of a flower pistil that contains the ovules and becomes the fruit
senses.definitionCN: 花柱基部中空的部分，内含胚珠，受精后发育成果实
senses.example: After fertilization the ovary swells into a fruit.
senses.exampleCN: 受精之后，子房膨大成为果实。
senses.why: Botanists reused the egg-keeper image because the plant chamber holds the seed eggs in the same way.
senses.whyCN: 植物学家借用了「藏卵之处」这个意象，因为植物的这个腔室同样把种子卵包裹在内。

senses.title: The part that holds ova
senses.definition: in zoology, the reproductive structure of invertebrates or fungi that holds ova and later eggs
senses.definitionCN: 动物学中无脊椎动物或真菌中容纳卵子与随后幼虫的生殖结构
senses.example: The tiny ovary of the sponge holds hundreds of eggs.
senses.exampleCN: 海绵体内小小的藏卵结构装着数百个卵。
senses.why: Once the core meaning is a chamber for eggs, the same label spreads to any such chamber in biology.
senses.whyCN: 一旦核心义确定为「装卵的腔室」，这个标签便扩展到生物学中所有类似结构。

senses.title: A female reproductive organ
senses.definition: in medical writing, any of the paired gonads of a female that produce eggs and female hormones
senses.definitionCN: 医学文献中指雌性成对的性腺，负责产生卵子和雌性激素
senses.example: The surgeon examined both ovaries before the operation.
senses.exampleCN: 手术前，外科医生检查了两侧卵巢。
senses.why: The egg organ is also a gland that releases hormones, so medical language uses the word for the whole reproductive function.
senses.whyCN: 这个产卵器官同时分泌激素，所以医学用语把它扩展为整个雌性生殖功能。

senses.title: The egg-producing stage
senses.definition: in insect and fish studies, the period or condition in which the ovaries are large and active
senses.definitionCN: 在昆虫与鱼类研究中，卵巢膨大而活跃的时期或状态
senses.example: The researchers sampled fish that were in ovary development.
senses.exampleCN: 研究人员采集处于卵巢发育阶段的鱼。
senses.why: Because the organ grows with the season, its name can stand for the breeding phase as well.
senses.whyCN: 由于该器官随季节增大，它的名字也可以代指繁殖阶段。

senses.title: The lower section of a flower
senses.titleCN: 子房位置；花托上的部位
senses.definition: in flower description, the position of the seed chamber, as in superior and inferior forms
senses.definitionCN: 描写花的结构时指种子腔所居的位置，如上位或下位
senses.example: This species has an inferior ovary beneath the petals.
senses.exampleCN: 这个物种的子房位于花瓣下方，属于下位子房。
senses.why: Detailed botanical description turns the part into a positional label attached to the flower base.
senses.whyCN: 细密的植物描写把这一部分变成附在花基部的方位标签。

intro.en: Ovary comes from Latin ovarium, egg-keeper, built on ovum, egg.
intro.cn: ovary 来自拉丁语 ovarium（藏卵之处），由 ovum（卵）构成。

items.en: Ovum means egg and gives many Latin compounds.
items.cn: ovum 意为「卵」，衍生出许多拉丁复合词。

items.en: Ovarium denotes the place where eggs are kept.
items.cn: ovarium 指存放卵子的地方。

items.en: Anatomical Latin uses ovarium for the egg organ of animals.
items.cn: 解剖学拉丁语用 ovarium 指动物的产卵器官。

items.en: English borrows the word as ovary in the anatomical sense.
items.cn: 英语借入这个词，作为指卵巢的解剖学术语。

items.en: Botany applies the same word to the seed chamber of a flower.
items.cn: 植物学又把同一个词用于花的种子腔。

items.en: The adjective ovarian is formed later for medical usage.
items.cn: 形容词 ovarian 后来形成，用于医学语境。

note.en: Ovary belongs to the ov- family of egg words and is close to ova, ovule, and ovary-related anatomy terms.
note.cn: ovary 属于 ov- 系列的「卵」词族，与 ova、ovule 以及相关的解剖学词相邻。

entries.definition: an egg cell released by an ovary
the small structure inside a plant ovary that becomes a seed
entries.definitionCN: 子房内部将发育成种子的小结构

entries.definition: egg-shaped, from the same Latin egg word
entries.definitionCN: 卵形的；与 ovum 同源，只是拼写相近但词义已转向形状

entries.definition: the general term for an organ producing eggs or sperm
entries.definitionCN: 产生卵子或精子的器官的通称

entries.definition: the organ where a young mammal grows before birth
entries.definitionCN: 子宫；哺乳动物胎儿成长的器官

entries.definition: the flower part containing the ovary, style, and stigma
entries.definitionCN: 花的雌蕊，包括子房、花柱与柱头

normalIntro.en: Ovary is the egg word with a place ending, so it keeps both the egg and the container in view.
normalIntro.cn: ovary 是「卵」加上表示「场所」的词尾，因此同时保留了「卵」与「容器」两层。

normal.en: Ov- means egg: ovum, ovule, and ovoid all start the same way.
normal.cn: ov- 表示「卵」：ovum、ovule、ovoid 都以同样的部分开头。

normal.en: The ending -ary marks a place, as in dictionary and sanctuary.
normal.cn: 词尾 -ary 表示场所，如 dictionary 与 sanctuary 中的用法。

normal.en: Ovarian cancer and ovarian cysts keep the medical adjective.
normal.cn: 卵巢癌与卵巢囊肿都使用医学形容词 ovarian。

normal.en: In flowers the ovary becomes the fruit after fertilization.
normal.cn: 在花中，子房受精后会变成果实。

normal.en: The plural is ovaries, with y turning into ies.
normal.cn: 复数是 ovaries，词尾 y 变为 ies。

abstract.en: Picture a small sac in the body holding round eggs like beads.
abstract.cn: 想象身体里一个小囊，像串珠子一样装着圆圆的小卵。

abstract.en: Imagine cutting a pear to find the seed chamber at its base.
abstract.cn: 想象把梨切开，在基部看到一小间装种子的腔室。

abstract.en: Think of a hive with tiny rooms, each one waiting for an egg.
abstract.cn: 想象一个蜂巢，每间小屋都在等一颗卵落进去。

examples.en: The doctor explained how each ovary produces an egg every month.
examples.cn: 医生解释了每个卵巢如何每月产生一个卵子。

examples.en: In the tomato flower the ovary develops into the fruit.
examples.cn: 在番茄的花里，子房发育成为果实。

examples.en: Removing one ovary usually does not prevent pregnancy.
examples.cn: 切除一侧卵巢通常不会妨碍怀孕。

dict_mnemonic.text: 「欧沃瑞」——听着像「偶窝卵」，一个小窝里放着卵，就是卵巢；这只是谐音联想，与词源无关。

root: 拉丁语 ovum（卵）+ -arium（场所、容器，名词词尾）→ ovarium「藏卵之处」→ 英语 ovary；核心是「装卵的容器」，因此在动物指卵巢，在植物指子房。

sensesIntro.en: Ovary keeps one core idea, a chamber that holds eggs, and works it out in human anatomy, botany, zoology, medicine, breeding phases, and flower structure.
sensesIntro.cn: ovary 只有一个核心义「装卵的腔室」，这一义在人体解剖、植物学、动物学、医学、繁殖阶段与花结构中得到不同展开。

core.en: CORE IMAGE: a small sac holding a row of eggs.
core.cn: 核心意象：一个小囊排着一列卵。

branches.en: The egg organ of a female body is the central sense.
branches.cn: 雌性体内的产卵器官是最中心的义项。

branches.en: The same organ also releases hormones, which gives the medical sense.
branches.cn: 同一器官还分泌激素，由此产生医学义项。

branches.en: Both plant seed chambers and invertebrate egg sacs reuse the container image.
branches.cn: 植物的种子腔与无脊椎动物的卵囊都沿用「容器」意象。

branches.en: A seasonal swollen organ stands for the breeding phase.
branches.cn: 季节性膨大的器官可代指繁殖阶段。

branches.en: Botanical description adds a positional tag to the same part.
branches.cn: 植物描写给同一结构加上方位标签。

intro.en: Ovary is built on ov-, the Latin root for egg, with the place ending -ary attached to it.
intro.cn: ovary 以表示「卵」的拉丁词根 ov- 为基础，加上表示场所的词尾 -ary。

latinIntro.en: Latin ovum is egg, and ovarium is its keeper, a place where eggs are stored.
latinIntro.cn: 拉丁语 ovum 是「卵」，ovarium 则是它的「保管处」，即存放卵子的地方。

items.example: The root ov- gives ovary its egg meaning.
items.exampleCN: 词根 ov- 赋予 ovary「卵」的含义。

items.example: Ovum is the bare Latin word for an egg.
items.exampleCN: ovum 就是拉丁语中「卵」的原形。

items.meaning: a place or a thing connected with
items.example: The suffix -ary marks a place, as in sanctuary.
items.exampleCN: 词尾 -ary 标记场所，如 sanctuary 所示。

items.example: Ovarium is the direct source of ovary.
items.exampleCN: ovarium 是 ovary 的直接来源。

items.example: The suffix -an forms ovarian.
items.exampleCN: 词尾 -an 构成 ovarian。

items.example: Ovarian describes cancer of the organ.
items.exampleCN: ovarian 用于描述该器官的癌症。

items.example: The suffix -ule forms ovule, a small egg.
items.exampleCN: 词尾 -ule 构成 ovule，即「小卵」。

items.meaning: the small egg in a plant ovary
items.example: Ovule sits inside the ovary.
items.exampleCN: 胚珠就在子房里面。

items.example: The suffix -oid forms ovoid.
items.exampleCN: 词尾 -oid 构成 ovoid。

items.example: Ovoid describes a shape like an egg.
items.exampleCN: ovoid 描述像卵一样的形状。

latinEntries.example: Ovum is the root of the whole family.
latinEntries.exampleCN: ovum 是整个词族的根源。

latinEntries.example: Ovarium gives English the organ name.
latinEntries.exampleCN: ovarium 给英语提供了这个器官的名称。

latinEntries.example: Ovalis shares the same egg root.
latinEntries.exampleCN: ovalis 共享同一个「卵」词根。

definition_zh: 拱覆；在……上方成拱形；涵盖贯穿
definition_en: to form an arch over something, or to cover and unite a group of things as a wider frame
core_image: 一座石拱从一侧桥墩跨到另一侧，把下方所有小路都罩在同一片弯拱之下
scene: 小镇的老教堂横跨三条巷子，拱顶把商铺和礼拜堂连成一体。A single arch overarches the square and unites the shops with the chapel.
sceneCN: 这里 overarch 是「拱覆」（第 1 个义项：在……上方形成拱形）；句意：一道拱门横跨广场，把商铺与礼拜堂连成一体。

derivatives.zh: overarch 加 -ing 构成形容词，最常用义为「统摄的；总体性的」
overarch 的核心词干，义为「拱；拱门」
与 arch 同源，义为「弧线；弧形」
源自拱廊概念，义为「拱廊；游乐厅」

senses.title: To form an arch over
senses.definition: to bend over something in the shape of an arch, as a bridge or vault does
senses.definitionCN: 像桥或拱顶那样呈弧形弯跨在某物上方
senses.example: A stone bridge overarches the narrow river.
senses.exampleCN: 一座石桥横跨这条窄河。
senses.why: Over means above and arch means a curved span, so the verb describes concrete stone or wood bending across a gap.
senses.whyCN: over 表示「在上方」，arch 表示「弯曲的跨度」，所以这个动词先描绘具体的石头或木头跨过空隙。

senses.title: To span several fields
senses.definition: to extend across and connect a number of fields, subjects, or groups
senses.definitionCN: 延伸跨越并连接若干领域、学科或群体
senses.example: The new theory overarches biology and computer science.
senses.exampleCN: 这一新理论横跨生物学与计算机科学。
senses.why: The arch image moves from space to knowledge, so a single idea bends over many separate subjects the way a bridge links two banks.
senses.whyCN: 「拱」的意象从空间转向知识：一个观念像桥连接两岸那样，弯跨于许多分离的学科之上。

senses.title: To act as an overall frame
senses.definition: to cover a set of smaller things as a wider scheme or plan that holds them together
senses.definitionCN: 以更宽泛的方案或计划罩住并统合一组较小的事物
senses.example: One overarch mission statement governs all five departments.
senses.exampleCN: 一个总体使命陈述统摄着所有五个部门。
senses.why: Once the arch is abstracted into a frame, the verb names the plan that sits above smaller ones and gives them unity.
senses.whyCN: 一旦「拱」被抽象成框架，这个动词就指那种居于较小计划之上、赋予它们统一性的总方案。

senses.title: To hold primacy over a period
senses.definition: to remain the dominant concern during a span of time, as an event or issue does
senses.definitionCN: 在一段时间内始终是主导性的关切，如某事件或议题
senses.example: A single dispute overarched the whole decade of talks.
senses.exampleCN: 一场争执贯穿了整整十年的谈判。
senses.why: Because an arch covers the space below it from end to end, the verb can mark a period that one issue covers from start to finish.
senses.whyCN: 因为拱从一端到另一端罩住下方空间，所以这个动词也能标记被某一议题从头罩到尾的时期。

senses.title: To outweigh; to hold precedence
senses.definition: to be more important than or take priority over something else
senses.definitionCN: 比别的事物更重要，或优先于别的事物
senses.example: In her letters caution overarches every other wish.
senses.exampleCN: 在她的信里，谨慎压过了所有其他愿望。
senses.why: Anything set above the rest visually outranks it, so the spatial image gives a sense of priority and weight.
senses.whyCN: 置于其余之上之物在视觉上便高出一等，于是空间意象便带来「优先与分量」的意味。

senses.title: To be arched above
senses.definition: to be covered or shaped by an arch from above, as a vaulted hall or a bent body
senses.definitionCN: 上方被拱形覆盖或塑形，如拱顶大厅或弓起的身体
senses.example: The long gallery was overarched by wooden beams.
senses.exampleCN: 长长的廊道被木梁拱起遮覆。
senses.why: The passive form keeps the literal arch and places the viewer under it, so the sense stresses the cover above rather than the span.
senses.whyCN: 被动式保留字面意义，并把观察者放在拱下，因而强调上方的覆盖而非跨度。

intro.en: Overarch joins the native prefix over, meaning above, to arch, from Latin arcus, a bow or curve.
intro.cn: overarch 由本土前缀 over（在上方）加上 arch 构成，后者出自拉丁语 arcus（弓、弧）。

items.en: Arcus means a bow, a curve, or an arch.
items.cn: arcus 意为弓、弧线或拱。

items.en: Arche names a curved architectural span and enters English through it.
items.cn: 古法语 arche 指弯曲的建筑跨度，英语经由它借入。

items.en: English arch covers bridges, vaults, and the curve of a bow.
items.cn: 中古英语 arch 涵盖桥梁、拱顶以及弓的弯曲。

items.en: Over is joined to arch to describe covering from above.
items.cn: over 与 arch 结合，用于描述从上方覆盖。

items.en: The sense of a dominant or underlying principle becomes common.
items.cn: 「主导性的、统摄性的原则」这一用法变得常见。

items.en: The adjective form overarch is most often seen as overarching in policy and academic writing.
items.cn: 现代英语中，这个动词的形容词形式在政策与学术写作里最为常见。

note.en: Overarch shares the Latin bow root with arch and archway, and its abstract senses are close to span, cover, and govern.
note.cn: overarch 与 arch、archway 共享拉丁「弓」词根，其抽象义则与 span、cover、govern 等词相邻。

entries.definition: a curved structure spanning an opening
a part of a curve
entries.definitionCN: 弧；弧形；与 arch 同出「弯曲」之根

entries.definition: a covered passage with arches along its sides
to extend across a distance or a period
entries.definitionCN: 跨越；横跨一段距离或时期

entries.definition: to include a wide range of things
to control or determine the working of something

normalIntro.en: Overarch is over plus arch, so a curved thing above is the picture that runs through every sense.
normalIntro.cn: overarch 就是 over 加上 arch，所以「上方有一道弯」这个画面贯穿了它所有义项。

normal.en: Arch comes from Latin arcus, a bow, so arch means a curve before it means a doorway.
normal.cn: arch 来自拉丁语 arcus（弓），所以它的第一义是「曲线」而非「门洞」。

normal.en: The adjective overarching appears far more often than the finite verb.
normal.cn: 形容词 overarching 的出现频率远高于动词的限定形式。

normal.en: An overarching theme is one idea that covers the whole book or report.
normal.cn: overarching theme 指覆盖整本书或整份报告的单一主题。

normal.en: Arch also forms archway, bridge, and vault words.
normal.cn: arch 还构成 archway、bridge、vault 等一组建筑词。

normal.en: Over- here means above, as in overhang and overlay.
normal.cn: 这里的 over- 表示「在上方」，与 overhang、overlay 相同。

abstract.en: Picture a stone arch joining two riverbanks and shading everything below.
abstract.cn: 想象一道石拱连接两岸，把下方的一切都罩在阴影里。

abstract.en: Imagine an umbrella of one idea spread over many separate desks.
abstract.cn: 想象一把由某个观念撑开的伞，罩住许多彼此分开的桌子。

abstract.en: Think of a rainbow bending over a whole valley at once.
abstract.cn: 想象一道彩虹同时弯跨整条山谷。

examples.en: An overarching goal unifies all the smaller projects.
examples.cn: 一个总体目标统一了所有较小的项目。

examples.en: Ivy overarched the old gate and shaded the path.
examples.cn: 常春藤在旧门上成拱，为小路遮阴。

examples.en: One question overarched the entire debate on housing.
examples.cn: 一个问题贯穿了整场关于住房的辩论。

dict_mnemonic.text: 「欧佛阿奇」——把 over 听成「欧佛」、arch 听成「阿奇」，想象阿奇撑开一把巨伞罩住全场；这只是谐音联想，与词源无关。

root: 古英语/本土前缀 over-（在上方）+ arch（拱，< 古法语 arche < 拉丁语 arcus「弓、弧」）→ overarch「在上方成拱」，引申为「涵盖、统摄」。

sensesIntro.en: Overarch begins with a literal curved span above something, widens to covering fields and periods, then to precedence, and finally to the passive image of being arched over.
sensesIntro.cn: overarch 先指上方真实的弧形跨度，再扩展为横跨多个领域与时期，随后转为「优先、居上」，最后是「被拱起覆盖」的被动图景。

core.en: CORE IMAGE: one stone arch covering everything beneath it.
core.cn: 核心意象：一道石拱罩住下方全部空间。

branches.en: A bridge or vault bending over a gap is the literal sense.
branches.cn: 跨过空隙的桥或拱顶是字面义项。

branches.en: Knowledge spanning several subjects reuses the bridge image.
branches.cn: 横跨多个学科的知识沿用了「桥」的意象。

branches.en: A wider plan sitting above smaller ones becomes an overall frame.
branches.cn: 居于较小计划之上的更宽方案成为总体框架。

branches.en: Covering a period or outranking a rival both grow from being set above.
branches.cn: 罩住一段时间或压倒对手，都源于「置于其上」。

branches.en: The passive keeps the literal arch and stresses the cover above.
branches.cn: 被动式保留字面的拱，强调上方的覆盖。

intro.en: Overarch is a transparent compound of over and arch, and arch is the part that carries the Latin bow root.
intro.cn: overarch 是 over 与 arch 构成的透明复合词，其中 arch 承载了拉丁语「弓」的词根。

latinIntro.en: Latin arcus, a bow, lies behind arch, and the same curve gives arc, arcade, and archway.
latinIntro.cn: arch 的词源是拉丁语 arcus（弓），同一「弯曲」概念也给出 arc、arcade 与 archway。

items.example: Over- places the arch above its object.
items.exampleCN: over- 把拱置于对象上方。

items.meaning: a curved structure spanning an opening
items.example: Arch supplies the curve in overarch.
items.exampleCN: arch 为 overarch 提供「弯曲」之意。

items.example: Arcus is the Latin source of arch.
items.exampleCN: arcus 是 arch 的拉丁语来源。

items.example: Arche carries the word into English.
items.exampleCN: arche 把这个词带入英语。

items.example: Arc keeps the bare curve.
items.exampleCN: arc 保留了纯粹的曲线义。

items.meaningCN: 构成分词或形容词的词尾
items.example: The suffix -ing forms overarching.
items.exampleCN: 词尾 -ing 构成 overarching。

items.meaning: covering everything as a wider frame
items.example: Overarching is the usual policy adjective.
items.exampleCN: overarching 是政策文本中的常用形容词。

items.example: Archway joins arch with way.
items.exampleCN: archway 由 arch 与 way 组合。

items.example: Arcade grows from the same curve root.
items.exampleCN: arcade 从同一个「弯曲」词根长出。

items.example: Overhang shares the over- prefix with overarch.
items.exampleCN: overhang 与 overarch 共用 over- 前缀。

latinEntries.example: Arcus is the root of the arch family.
Arcuare is the verb of bending.
latinEntries.exampleCN: arcuare 是表示「弯曲」的动词。
